build: Debug builds during this milestone; exact-source final Release assertions are stored separately in probe.json.
method: Native UI automation of the app, plus direct executable launch with --controls when the saved pet was hidden. App-targeted automation may activate the target, so these are not physical cross-app focus checks.
observations: A normal autonomous blink ran after launch: Quiet moments changed from 0 to 1; an ordinary next deadline was scheduled.
Quiet Behavior off, Pause on, Hide Pet on produced no scheduled deadline.
After quitting and relaunching, controls showed Quiet Behavior off, Pause on, Hide Pet on, click-through off, all-Spaces on, and no deadline.
Starting a diagnostic temporarily showed/unpaused the pet and enabled click-through. Cancel Check restored all original choices and no deadline.
Starting another diagnostic then quitting ended the process (exit 0, no remaining Spriglet process).
A subsequent new process still loaded the original hidden/paused/quiet-off choices; transient diagnostic values had not overwritten them.
Original default choices were restored after testing: shown, unpaused, quiet behavior on, click-through off, all-Spaces on.
Nap transitioned Active→Napping and scheduled one resting deadline; Wake Up transitioned Active→Resting and scheduled the next deadline.
toolLimitation: With every pet window hidden and the controls scene suppressed, the automation initial-window lookup timed out although the process was running. The optional --controls launch flag presents controls without changing saved pet settings.

memoryObservation.scope: Separate live Debug process with controls open, not the Release probe
memoryObservation.meaning: This process peak had fallen at the snapshot; this does not identify the Release spike cause or establish a memory budget.

remaining: Physical cross-app click/focus, transparent host compositing over known backgrounds, multi-display and actual OS sleep/Reduce Motion transitions, GPU/energy and long soak tests remain open.
